snippet.title: Chains of Lukomorye | Announcement Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
The war is over. Or is it?

The ritual ended the war but cracked the world. Myths seep into broken trenches and forgotten villages, and something ancient stirs in the dark. 

Chains of Lukomorye is an action-adventure set in an alternate post-WWI world. Wishlist now on Steam.
